verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public GitHub repository for the Azure CLI (github.com/Azure/azure-cli), and the official MCP server is documented at github.com/microsoft/mcp, so some first-party tooling source appears readable. Nothing in the pack states an open license for either repo, and nothing covers source for the core Azure platform or services. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license for the published repos, source availability for the core platform beyond client tooling, independent corroboration.
